tagline: Dual focal length cameras胶片相机，1988 年发布
description: Dual focal length cameras于1988年推出的胶片相机。快门速度1/9–1/200 s.。使用Auto-loading, auto-winding, manually activated motor rewind.。感光度DX coded films ISO 100–400.。Active infrared autofocus with focus lock, 1.5 m to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Active infrared autofocus with focus lock, 1.5 m to infinity.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in. Range from 1.5 m to 4.5 m (wide) or 3 m (tele).
specs.胶片/画幅: Auto-loading, auto-winding, manually activated motor rewind.
specs.英文简介: The Musashi TW (Tele Wide) was released in 1988 under Iwata Enterprises' Selby brand.
